| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Base filter** `base` | Guided filter | Guided filter, Bilateral filter | The edge-preserving filter that makes the base layer. |
| **Boost** `boost` | 5 | 0 to 20 | The factor k on the detail layer. 1 gives the input back, 0 gives the base. |
| **Guided radius** `radius` | 16 | 1 to 64 px | The radius r of the guided filter's windows, for the guided base. |
| **Guided regularization** `eps` | 0.01 | 0.0001 to 1 | The guided filter's penalty eps, for values from 0 to 1. 0.01 is 0.1 squared. |
| **Bilateral spatial sigma** `sigmaSpace` | 16 | 1 to 100 px | The spatial scale sigma_s of the bilateral filter, for the bilateral base. |
| **Bilateral range sigma** `sigmaRange` | 25.5 | 1 to 255 | The range scale sigma_r of the bilateral filter, in levels from 0 to 255. 25.5 is 0.1 of the range. |
| **Bilateral downsampling** `downsample` | 1 | 1 to 16 | The bilateral base is filtered on every z-th pixel, as Durand and Dorsey do for speed. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect 101 (default) | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
| **Output mapping** `outputMapping` | Clip to 0 to 255 | Absolute value, Offset by 128, Stretch to full range, Clip to 0 to 255 | How signed results, such as gradients, become 8-bit pixel values. |
| **Channels** `channelScope` | RGB | RGB, Brightness only | Which part of the color image the filter changes. |
